state.product: The Daily Consensus free public market research desk
state.task: Restore individual instrument research alongside the existing market-wide publication. Five initial reports cover SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA and TLT. These are new source-linked editorial reports, not claims that these exact five symbols were the original historical set.
constraints: Keep the existing Next.js/React implementation and token system
No login, paywall or runtime paid model generation
Reports are authored once with the Codex subscription and served as validated saved publications
Support keyboard navigation, 390px mobile layouts, light and dark themes, reduced motion
Never label weekly CFTC futures positioning as ETF fund flows or an intraday prediction
Do not show fabricated conviction percentages, price levels, options or gamma values
An unsupported symbol must show an honest unavailable state, not a market-wide report mislabeled as instrument research
componentCatalog: Slim sidebar and mobile navigation dialog
ResearchBriefPanel with headline, summary, supporting views, counterpoints, watch items, linked citations and expandable limitations
Hosted TradingView chart and technical panels

initialCoverage: TLT: Treasury futures and interest-rate context
missingData: No raw public licensed prices, support/resistance calculation or options chain

entry.instructions: Choose where readers should open the five instrument reports while keeping market-wide and instrument research clearly distinguished.

criteria.dedicated_view: Add an Instrument reports sidebar/mobile-nav item. Reuse the existing research panel within that view, with a visible five-instrument chooser.
criteria.brief_scope_switch: Keep all publications within Daily Brief and add a Market / Instrument selector above its panel.
criteria.index_routes: Add a linked report index and separate static article pages, without an in-workspace reports view.
criteria.expand_candidates: None of these arrangements serves the constraints.

chooser.instructions: Choose the compact accessible instrument selector for exactly five supported reports. It must wrap naturally at 390px and remain clearly labelled.

criteria.button_group: A labelled group of five ticker buttons with instrument names and aria-pressed selection; wrap into rows on small screens.
criteria.native_select: A labelled native select with ticker and instrument name for each of the five reports.
criteria.summary_cards: Five large cards each with an editorial headline and publication date before the selected report.

context.instructions: Choose how to place hosted market views relative to the published instrument report. Provider data cannot be extracted into the report.

criteria.report_then_link: Show the published report first and one clear action to open the existing Market & technical view for that ticker.
criteria.report_then_chart: Show the report followed by the existing hosted chart on the same view, clearly separated from cited editorial evidence.
criteria.side_by_side: Place the report next to the hosted technical widget on wide screens and stack them on phones.
